editorial_scope: Beer packaging from chemistry to the consumer: quality, storage, pressure, history, material contact, regulatory dates and lifecycle boundaries. Research drafts only.

sources.title: Packaging choice and coordinated distribution logistics to reduce the environmental footprint of small-scale beer value chains (2022)
sources.author_label: Dyfed Rhys Morgan, David Styles and Eifiona Thomas Lane
sources.access_scope: Full PubMed abstract from a seven-microbrewery LCA comparing reusable glass, aluminum cans, PET and steel kegs and distribution. The complete modeling inventory was not independently re-calculated; case and transport boundaries govern findings.

sources.title: Identifying the most sustainable beer packaging through a Life Cycle Assessment (2024)
sources.author_label: Luca Marrucci, Tiberio Daddi and Fabio Iraldo
sources.access_scope: PubMed indexed abstract of beer packaged in PET kegs, glass bottles and cans, with transport and recycled-content sensitivity analyses. Publisher full text was blocked; its favorable PET-keg result is case-specific.

sources.title: Life cycle assessment of reusable food and beverage packaging systems: A proposal of good practice (2025)
sources.access_scope: Public publisher abstract and highlights describing methodological boundary choices, food losses and the need to recheck modeled reusable systems with real operating data; not a beer-specific field measurement.

sources.title: Insight into environmental impacts of beer: the role of economy of scale and glass bottle challenge in international trade (2025)
sources.author_label: Czech brewery and malt-house life-cycle researchers
sources.access_scope: Open published abstract/highlights on Czech brewery scales, packaging and export trade; study-specific primary data, not a universal bottle-versus-can ranking.

sources.title: Regulation (EU) 2025/40 on packaging and packaging waste
sources.author_label: European Parliament and Council of the European Union
sources.access_scope: Official EUR-Lex act and European Commission summaries; applicable from 12 August 2026 with differing later targets, exceptions and product conditions. Full clause-by-clause compliance analysis not performed.

sources.title: Commission Notice C/2026/3084 interpreting Regulation (EU) 2025/40 (10 June 2026)
sources.access_scope: Public indexed Commission guidance dated 10 June 2026 including distinction between HORECA kegs sold to venues and consumer sales packaging; detailed applicability to any actual operator not independently assessed.

sources.title: New packaging rules for less waste and easier recycling (12 August 2026)
sources.access_scope: Full Commission announcement of 12 August 2026 application, future recycling/reuse objectives and exclusions; a dated rule application, not evidence of an annual public festival or immediate full 2030 compliance.

sources.title: Facts about the new EU rules on packaging and packaging waste
sources.access_scope: Full public Commission Q&A with packaging lifecycle, recycling, reuse, deposit and hygiene context; explanatory rather than independent legal advice or evidence a specific beer package complies.

sources.title: Commission Regulation (EU) 2024/3190 concerning BPA and other bisphenols in food-contact articles
sources.access_scope: Full official primary legal text, corrected and consolidated in February 2026. Some coatings and packages have transitional or derogation conditions; not a global beer-can safety judgment.

sources.title: Food-contact materials: EU legislation and 2026 BPA correction
sources.author_label: European Commission, Directorate-General for Health and Food Safety
sources.access_scope: Full public Commission legislation index identifying Regulation 2024/3190 and correction Regulation 2026/250; not evidence that every can has BPA or that every alternative coating is approved.

sources.title: Influence of Selected Technological Conditions on the Flavour Stability of Unpasteurised Top-Fermented Craft Beer (2025)
sources.author_label: Giovanni De Francesco, Valeria Sileoni and Ombretta Marconi
sources.access_scope: Full open paper: studied a particular unpasteurized top-fermented beer under filtration, temperature and yeast-addition conditions, with instrumental and trained-panel results. Its outcomes are not a universally valid process or storage prescription.

sources.title: Factors Affecting Beer Quality During Storage – A Review (2024)
sources.author_label: Krystian Klimczak, Monika Cioch-Skoneczny and Aleksander Poreda
sources.access_scope: Public scholarly abstract summarizing beer-dependent staling chemistry, aldehydes, ester/terpene changes, storage and time; no new universal shelf-life trial.

sources.title: Technological strategies for controlling aldehyde formation in beer: a review of brewing-related flavour instability (2025)
sources.author_label: Maciej Ditrych, Guido Aerts and Mogens Larsen Andersen
sources.access_scope: Full publisher page, abstract and bibliographic record (PDF linked but not independently analyzed) discussing multiple aldehyde pathways, oxidation, heat, yeast, packaging and light; not one experimental recipe.

sources.title: Effect of UV Filters during the Application of Pulsed Light to Reduce Lactobacillus brevis Contamination and 3-Methylbut-2-ene-1-thiol Formation (2023)
sources.access_scope: PMC indexed abstract and selected sections covering two beer matrices, L. brevis reductions, lightstruck thiol and UV filters; direct full page blocked verification. No industrial disinfection or home sterilization protocol.

sources.title: Photooxidative degradation of beer bittering principles: a key step on the route to lightstruck flavor formation in beer (2005)
sources.access_scope: EPA HERO bibliographic record and abstract of radical-spin-trapping study of hop-derived bittering compounds and excited riboflavin; no finished-beer packaging performance or sensory panel examined.

sources.title: Beer Freshness Series (2024)
sources.access_scope: Full public resource description introducing oxygen sensors and freshness across brewing, cellaring and packaging; detailed articles require member login, so operating targets are not inferred.

sources.title: EBC 11.5.1: Total dissolved and headspace oxygen in packaged beer
sources.access_scope: Search-indexed method summary (direct site returned 503) listing both dissolved and headspace phases for bottle, can, keg and cask. Complete normative method unavailable; no universal oxygen specification claimed.

sources.title: Preventing Package Over-Pressurization (1 February 2026)
sources.access_scope: Full public BA description of hazards from unintended package refermentation and producer responsibility; detailed linked download not examined, no pressure or priming instructions given.

sources.title: US Patent 468,226: Bottle-sealing device (2 February 1892)
sources.author_label: William Painter; United States Patent Office
sources.access_scope: Public US patent bibliographic record and original specification for a crimped metallic crown and compressible liner; grant date is an archival date, not the first beer-bottling date or yearly festival.

sources.title: Crown Cork & Seal corporate history
sources.access_scope: Full public manufacturer-authored chronology of Painter's 1892 cap, 1898 automation and company development; producer history is not independent proof of every industry's practices.

sources.title: American Beer Can with Handle, NMAH nmah_867074
sources.author_label: Smithsonian National Museum of American History
sources.access_scope: Public museum object catalogue: American Brewery, Inc., Baltimore; Continental Can; handle and Walter Voigt collection, historical business context. Museum images carry rights conditions; no image copied.

sources.title: Crown Cork and Soda Filling Machine, ASME Landmark 174
sources.access_scope: Public ASME engineering landmark record linking Painter's 2 February 1892 cap patent to later machines; industrial heritage source, not independent sensory tests.
